_header: toolkit-permissions.json - the ONE committed, tool-agnostic list of what the toolkit's auto loop
may run unattended. Every tool's permission file is TRANSLATED from this list by
.claude/scripts/build-layouts.js and the installers; nothing reads any tool's file as a seed.
Grammar:
groups[]        one entry per row of the Permissions table in .claude/rules/toolkit.md, in
the same order. 'purpose' is the table's reason column, so every prefix has a
named reason; an entry not in that table needs a named loop step as its reason.
prefixes[]      command prefixes as a human would type them. NEVER an absolute path: the
per-machine files these feed (Cursor, Antigravity) apply to every project on
the machine, so an entry must hold from any project root.
tools           'all', or a list drawn from claude | codex | cursor | antigravity. A prefix a
tool cannot run, or should not, is scoped away here.
optional        'gitlab' marks the glab rows: included only when the repo's origin is on
gitlab.com (the same substring test as .claude/skills/shared/host-cli.md).
claudeCode      entries that exist only in Claude Code's own grammar (tool names, Skill,
WebFetch domains, the piped browse.js forms, additionalDirectories,
defaultMode). The Claude Code translator passes them through verbatim; every
other translator ignores them.
Translation rules live in the build script, not here: this file names WHAT may run, each
tool's emitter decides HOW its grammar says so (Claude Code Bash(prefix *), Codex prefix_rule,
Cursor terminalAllowlist, Antigravity command(prefix)).
